description: Frictionless Table Schema of Platform/01-store/forms/write-checks.tsv (ADR-0125 addenda (12), (13); OBSH.39.3). Every field is a raw string: no type coercion. Constraints only where the header of the form or the existing check states them; CEL, JSON, owner, typed, numeric and prose-agreement rules stay with the existing checks (raw map of the change 0125-forms-table-schema-p01).

fields.name: n
fields.description: The order 1, 2, …; physical order stays with the existing check.

fields.name: id
fields.description: wc-<check> or wc-batch_<check>, stable, not renumbered.

fields.name: op
fields.description: * or a comma list of values of body.op.

fields.name: each
fields.description: CEL; checked by the existing CEL guard on the raw text, not by this schema.

fields.name: when
fields.description: CEL; checked by the existing CEL guard on the raw text, not by this schema.

fields.name: fault
fields.description: CEL; checked by the existing CEL guard on the raw text, not by this schema. Empty: no fields.
